system.name: Charon
system.description: A single-user agent operating system: a Rust TUI over a Python backend that runs conversation engines, workers (shades), memory and providers.

subsystems.name: Core runtime
subsystems.description: Conversation engine, agents, context assembly, the main loop and shared infrastructure.

subsystems.name: Tools
subsystems.description: The tool surface an agent calls: files, shell, git, browser, delegation, memory, the system map.

subsystems.name: Providers
subsystems.description: LLM adapters, routing between them, auth, model registry and effort policy.

subsystems.name: Orchestration
subsystems.description: Shades, judge loops, automation, fleet and the workspace control plane.

subsystems.name: User interface
subsystems.description: The Rust TUI, its Python backend, Graph Studio, charon-viz and the CLI.

subsystems.name: Research & evaluation
subsystems.description: Libris, IPMS, benchmarks, the gym and the test suite.

subsystems.name: Documentation & assets
subsystems.description: Docs, plans, skills, the design library, examples and repo metadata.
